source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine - Engine Mechanical V8, p.6-38

procedures.title: Engine front mount (V8): replace
steps: Remove the nut, washer and mount through-bolt.
Raise the engine to take its weight off the mount.
Unbolt the mount from the engine.
Fit the new mount to the engine.
Lower the engine, install the through-bolt and torque all mount bolts to specifications.

procedures.title: Engine rear mount (V8): replace
steps: Raise the transmission to unload the mount.
Remove the mount-to-transmission bolts and the mount.
Fit the new mount to the transmission.
Lower the transmission, lining up and starting the crossmember-to-mount bolts on the way down.
Lower fully and torque all mount bolts to specifications.
notes: Full-size Chevrolets also have a spacer under the rear mount.

procedures.title: Torque sequence: cylinder head and intake manifold (V8)
steps: Tighten cylinder head and intake manifold bolts in the numbered order shown for the engine in figure 1T in the manual: 327 (302/307/350) and 427 (396) have separate diagrams.
The sequences start at the center of the head or manifold and work outward toward the ends.
